purpose: Controlled measured-temperature masking only; no incision/melt target used
block_selector: For each duration separately, consecutive nonoverlapping calendar blocks from window_start, start increment exactly duration; retain only 100% native supported intervals and finite supported endpoints. No outcome/error-based selection.
truth: Exact piecewise-linear native temperature time integral over fully supported mask
methods_definition: Use only temperatures exactly at left/right mask endpoints. Interior temperature readings withheld from reconstruction; true integral evaluated separately.
primary_metric: Mean absolute error of mask-average temperature in degrees C
secondary_metrics: root mean squared average-temperature error C
overlap: Blocks nonoverlapping within station/duration. Different durations overlap each other; stations share environment. Not independent replications.
limitations: Conditional masking over observed support is not random missingness in actual gaps. Actual gaps may coincide with sensor handling/calibration and cannot be guaranteed reconstructed by these errors.
No confidence interval inferred from correlated blocks.
Linear bridge and next endpoint require future observations and are retrospective gap reconstruction, not causal forecasting.
No reconstruction of unknown bulk-minus-floor offset.
